title: Qualify exact real formal polynomial derivatives and typed unit refusal in M4-W02
commitMessage: feat: qualify exact formal polynomial differentiation and real function domains

contribution.summary: Qualify M4-W02-C01-T1 through a real compiled missing-API RED, 38 independent GREEN tests and eight NuGet-only consumer oracles. Add provider-free exact formal real functions and polynomial derivatives: d(x^3)/dx=3x^2, absent variable=0, sums and constant products, with explicit domain/codomain, source/wrt provenance, bounded power eight, and typed refusal of units, assumptions, bound symbols and unproved analytic forms. Verify preview.5 local NuGet hashes and relevant IR/quantity suites.
contribution.value: Deliver the first independently consumable exact real symbolic derivative without silently dropping units, domain restrictions or uncertain differentiability, and without a CAS runtime or broker.
debtChanges: Execute a compiled missing-public-derivative-contract RED against the existing real preview.4 symbolics assembly before staging the new implementation.
38 scientific GREEN tests cover exact cubic and absent-variable derivatives, polynomial sums and constant products, negative/fractional coefficients and power limits.
Explicit SymbolicRealFunction carries free real parameter/domain/codomain; bound/integer variables, unit literals, prior restrictions and unsupported analytic shapes receive distinct typed refusals.
Local rule ID, canonical IR source semantic SHA-256 and differentiation variable identity accompany only admitted exact derivatives; refused results contain no mathematical proof.
Eight NuGet-only real .NET10 consumer oracles check exact calculus, independent variable zero, unit/nondifferentiability refusal, exponent budget and no external CAS dependencies.
Three local product archives are verified with a separate C# nuspec/SHA-256 inspector; the canonical solution builds locked and relevant symbolics, IR and quantities tests pass.
Only C01-T1 R/G/V and T1 complete; M4-W02/C01 enter in-progress, T2 and C02 remain not-ready, and M4 release/AURA/dw.discovery agent rights remain unqualified.
contribution.nextAction: After durable RS059 success, prepare M4-W02-C01-T2 with explicit differentiability/singularity and derived-unit boundaries, refusal of unsupported functions and controlled scientific tests.

achievements.achievement: Demonstrate a compiled absent-API RED against the real preview.4 symbolics assembly, proving the new public formal derivative contract is not already present.
Deliver exact free-real polynomial differentiation with typed domain/unit/assumption refusals and pass 38 independent GREEN tests plus eight package-only oracles.
Verify complete relevant symbolics/IR/quantity regressions, locked .NET10 solution, actual preview.5 local NuGet provenance and no foreign CAS or broker dependency.
Qualify M4-W02-C01-T1 as a provider-independent exact formal real polynomial derivative capability, while preserving unfinished C01-T2, W02 and M4 boundaries.
